race.verdict: Not much pace on paper, which may give lightly-raced MIDNIGHT BELLA the edge over course-regular Gilbertina . Eskimo Sam also needs a look with a run under her belt. MIDNIGHT BELLA GILBERTINA ESKIMO SAM
